about: The one construction of the Sylphx mark, wordmark and lockups (direction Altitude, 2026-11-16; directions/2026-11-altitude.md). logo/construction/mark.py draws every file in logo/ from this spec; change the spec and rerun, never edit an output by hand.

mark.about: Two wings, one current. Two identical solid blades, the second the first rotated 180 degrees about the centre of the grid; together they read as an S, a pair of wings and a stream of air. The blade is drawn on a 64 grid and the masters are output on a 512 grid (every coordinate times 8).

colours.about: Mark colours. The colour versions fill both blades with one gradient, the current, which runs across the pair's bounding box from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2), given as fractions of the box. 'ink' and 'paper' set the wordmark on light and dark grounds; 'field' is the ground of the tile, favicon and app icon; 'accent' is the middle of the current, used for the guides on the usage sheet.

wordmark.about: Sylphx in Geist SemiBold with tight tracking, outlined.

lockup.about: Mark beside the wordmark. The mark's height is a multiple of the wordmark's cap height, centred on it; the gap is a fraction of the mark height.

clear_space.about: Keep this much empty space around any version, as a fraction of the mark height.

favicon.about: The favicon is the tile as a vector: the rounded field with the mark in the current. At and below flat_mark_max_px the gradient has too few pixels to read, so the PNG and ICO frames draw the mark flat in flat_mark_colour.

app_icon.about: Store and home-screen icons are full-bleed: the platform applies its own corner mask. The mark sits inside the iOS and Android safe areas.
